deduction_items.error_predicate: R28: span with Latin letters >= 20 and > CJK characters; instances keyed by heading path
deduction_items.negative_context_exclusions: Not a content predicate: it reads the whole deliverable (or its directory) and never charges ordinary omission of detail inside a unit.
deduction_items.relation_to_positive_items: Gate; content items read Chinese predicates, so an English section also loses their credit.

normalization_rules.operation:
UTF-8 decode, NFKC fold, drop Markdown emphasis, code ticks and link targets; tables become cell lines split at
with row and column headers, lists become items with lead-in, paragraphs become sentences split at 。！？, fenced blocks become lines
map body aliases to 集团, 股份, 酒店BU (酒店事业部/酒管公司), 投资BU (投资事业部) and 养老公司, in that priority with masking (task_aliases)

decision item = subject token (集团/股份/酒店/核心酒店/其他酒店/养老/多元/孵化/辖下企业) joined only by 的/之/整体/层面 or a short parenthetical to a strategy token (组合战略, 投融资战略, 发展战略/发展规划/战略规划, 竞争战略/竞争策略/经营策略); missing subject inherits from the previous item, row header, lead-in or heading
role tokens fold to draft (制定/起草/拟定/编制/提出/提议/牵头/主导), review (初审/审核/审查/预审/复核/把关/评审/审议), final (终审/审批/批准/核准/审定/决策/决定/最终审批); a table label line 制定：/终审： sets the role for following lines of the same cell
target receivers fold to 酒店BU, 投资BU, incubation, hotel units (每个/各/所有/单体 酒店, 核心酒店), enterprise units (每个/各/辖下 企业/经营单位/多元业务), hotel, pension and diversified aggregates
declared gap markers fold into one gap observation that cannot carry fabrication (D10 skips the span)
quoted substrings carrying a role word or issuing verb are replaced by a quote marker and lose adoption; other quotes are unwrapped

a legend span defining at least two single-character codes (码=含义) maps each code whose meaning names exactly one role class to that role; inside table cells a standalone code (not adjacent to another CJK character) is read as that role word; codes whose meaning names no role (执, 知, —) stay non-roles

derivation_rules.operation: spans under headings containing 现状/诊断/案例/借鉴/备选/不采纳/未采纳/附录/背景/回顾/思考/问题/参考 are out of scope

architecture variant from the nearest table column header, row header or deepest heading naming N+1 or 2型; a source naming both is 'both' and scores neither; near-term decision and target observations exclude variant spans
adoption status from candidate markers and rejection markers
keyword spray: span over 300 characters, more than 8 decision items, or a clause with at least 3 bodies and 3 role words

pair each role with the nearest preceding body (coordinated 与/和/及/、 bodies share it), else a body at most 8 characters after it, else the inherited context body (table header, lead-in, heading, previous clause); drop a pair when 不/非/而非/无需/未/无权 occurs from 3 characters before the pair to its end

target issuing: in a clause with 目标/预算/指标 context and an issuing verb, issuer is the body after 由 or the nearest body before the verb not preceded by 向/对/给/至/到/为; in a target table the column or row body is the issuer, and a column headed 下达方/下达主体/由谁下达 makes the cell body the issuer and the row body the receiver; receivers are N05 tokens and other bodies; clauses stating 按管理关系/去法人 or negated issuing are rule clauses

aggregate triples per item into draft/review/final body sets; the final body is the highest ranked (集团 > 股份 = 养老公司 > BU) and lower final bodies count as review; three or more bodies in one slot is ambiguous

shape counters: S01 whole text, S04 and S05 characters under the heading naming N+1 or 2型; S04 or S05 is not applicable when the variant has no heading section of its own; every overrun manifestation shares damage key shape:overrun and every underrun shares shape:underrun, because nested units measure one length cause; each shape occurrence cites the first view of its section not already cited by an earlier shape occurrence

investment approval: clause with 投资/资产变更/并购 after masking body and item names (or an investment row header), roles paired by R05; clauses are paired one comma clause at a time with the body carried from the previous clause, and a sentence is in investment context from its first investment clause; 轻资产/重资产 and negated mentions (不涉及/不含/不包括/非 …投资) are not investment words

arrow trees: a fenced line containing → and a target word or issuing verb issues from the body named before the arrow, else from the nearest shallower fenced line in the same block naming exactly one body; receivers are read after the arrow; 养老公司 as a group receiver counts as the pension aggregate. Header-bound receivers: a table cell under a body column with an issuing verb or a final role, in a row whose header carries a target word, issues to the receivers named in the row header

N+1 new BU also from 由(原)孵化业务 升级/升为/转为 with a BU named in the span or its table row; the entity half reads 实体 in the span or its row and no 虚拟. 2型 D04 control levels: an affirmed count of three to five control levels (N级管控, 管控仍为N级) without transition wording next to it; D04 entity hotel BU also from 酒店BU（实体…） or a table row whose cell 酒店BU sits beside a cell starting with 实体. R05 pair negation window includes 没有/无, and an inherited body is negated by anything earlier in its clause

legend codes are also expanded in table column headers; in a role-column table (column header is one role) the decision item is read from the first other cell of the row that names an item, the body must be named in the cell (no inheritance from the row header), and dash or empty cells produce nothing; an item named in brackets next to an item outside brackets is a cross-reference, not a decision; decision scope resets at sentence ends; unit subjects include 其他…酒店, 酒店经营单位, 酒管公司 and (各/每个)存续业务, and a subject may be followed by a bracket of up to 40 characters; investment context in role-column tables also comes from the row's cells, and 投资发展部/投资孵化 are department names, not investment words; a clause 向X下达 in an issuer row takes the row or column body as issuer; the boundary window between 集团不 and 下达 is 40 characters; receivers accept 全部 and 业务, and a hotel BU's operating units count as its hotel units; 无论/不论…是否 is not a candidate marker; list items under a long-term heading whose lead-in says the decisions are common to both variants belong to both variant pools; 管控层级：N级 is a control-level count for P12, P13, D04 and D05; 集团最终只持有平台 counts as group-held businesses moved; 孵化业务…升为/转为 BU counts as a new BU; ledger text renders sets sorted so results do not depend on the hash seed

a column header is a role column only when it is at most four characters, names one role class, is not a matter header (决策, 事项, 内容) and is not negated; cells under a negated header (不做, 不负责, 不参与, 无权, 不包括, 不决定) are not paired; row investment context comes only from matter cells (事项, 决策, 内容, 对象, 项目, 范围); 参股 alone is not an investment word and clauses stating approval authority lies elsewhere (权限之外, 除外) are skipped; legend meanings end at whitespace and a code touching 并/与/和/及 is still a code; the row subject in a role-column table comes from its scope cell; unit subjects include 自有/委托/特许/合资/参股…酒店 lists; portfolio tokens include 资源配比, 内部组合, 之间的组合, and a portfolio token near 集团 without 股份 is the group portfolio; target trees accept ▶, ►, ⇒ and ->; a table cell line starting with an arrow issues from its row or column body; the group boundary object may be any 单位; level counts accept digits (3 级管控, 2 级管控); new BU verbs include 设为, 升格, 上升为

portfolio tokens (产业|业务)组合 not followed by 方式/管理/战略, 节奏配比 and 规模与节奏的配比; set subjects 存续业务组合, 存续业务群 and 投资BU所辖…业务群 are the diversified set; in role-column investment tables the body must be named in the cell and matter headers count as investment context; under a header role, bodies inside brackets are ignored when a body is named outside brackets (unclosed brackets included) and a negation up to six characters before a body drops it; list items and sentences starting with a single body and an arrow issue targets from that body, and under a target heading the receivers need no target word; target context reads the nearest heading; a variant table row headed 管控层级 whose cell starts with N级 is a level count for P12, P13, D04 and D05; new BU verbs include 各设; the entity half reads 实体 in the new-BU sentence or its row

a bare 决策 column header placed after a role column is the final-role column; in a role column, bodies outside brackets take the column role when the text outside brackets names no role, bracketed notes pair only their own explicit roles, bracket bodies stand in only when no body is named outside and the bracket opens in the clause, a body followed in its sentence by 不参与/不涉及/不介入/无权/不负责/不决定/不审批/授权 or negated within its window takes no role, a conditional clause (…时) assigns nothing and carries no body; a scope cell 集团/股份公司 + 整体/层面/总部/本部 names that subject and an inherited subject overrides the portfolio nearby-word fallback; N09 elliptical lists sharing one head noun (发展、竞争与投融资战略) name one strategy per member; the architecture-common marker ignores the document title heading; 下达关系/路径/方式/体系/机制/流程 are nouns, not issuing acts; receivers accept 电商、物业 as the incubation businesses (material.md 1126) and 所有/全部/各 + holding-type words + 酒店 as hotel units; the 2型 listed-platform half reads the whole paragraph or list block; the 2型 two-level half is not credited when every two-level statement is scoped to one segment or platform (板块/平台/一线 …2级) and the same 2型 pool affirms three to five levels; D04 hotel entity accepts the label 酒店BU：(为)实体

legends may define single uppercase Latin codes (D=起草, R=审核, F=最终决策), expanded in cells only when no other Latin letter touches them; in a decision matrix whose column headers name bodies, the decision item is read from the row's non-body, non-role cells and the role from the code in the body column; a subject phrase followed by a bracketed lowercase alias of one or two letters (多元投资与孵化业务（n）) defines that alias for the document, while uppercase brackets such as (BU) are labels; overlapping subject tokens resolve to the longest match; 存续(多元)业务集合/整体 is the diversified set and 存续(多元业务)单位 the unit subject; 投融资安排 is an investment-financing token; 养怡公司 names the pension company; in a target clause a body followed by 负责/承办/跟踪/准备/落实/统筹/支持/协助 is an executor, not a receiver; a list of two or more holding-type words before 酒店 is a hotel-units receiver; N+1 level count accepts 管控层(级)为…三级, moves accept 集团直管企业清零 or 集团不再直管经营单位 and read the table row header with its cell, and an upgrade to a BU in one sentence of a list item counts when the same item states the incubation or scale trigger; 2型 hotel BU without departments accepts 不再拥有/不再有部门, functions lifted to the listed-company headquarters in prose or list items count when the variant makes the hotel BU without departments, and related industries read a row header 酒店生活板块（股份公司）

in a table whose headers name 下达方 and 接收方, the row's issuer body issues to the bodies and receiver tokens of the 接收方 cell and to the aggregates named in the content cell, while cells under 编制/跟踪/承办/证据/依据/说明/备注 headers are not issuing lines; a body followed by 负责/落实/跟踪 or by 不是/并非/不作为下达方 is neither issuer nor receiver; strategy tokens accept 发展计划, 竞争规划 and 投资规划/计划, and elliptical lists accept 投资 and the heads 规划/计划; a bracketed clarification does not cancel the subject named outside it; matter headers include 标准/判定/条件; the investment BU positioning halves read only clauses naming 投资BU unless the span names no body and its context body is 投资BU; the boundary accepts 管理关系已转入(股份/酒店BU/投资BU)…目标随管理关系; the principle may span a comma; level counts accept N个控制/管控层级, and a two-level count scoped to a segment line (板块/平台/线) earns no two-level credit while the 2型 pool affirms three levels; the new-BU trigger rule also reads the other sentences of the same table cell; related industries accept the row header 股份公司（酒店生活板块）; sections headed 自查/自检 are excluded
是否X由Y决定/决策/审批/批准 assigns a decision and is not a candidate marker

elliptical lists accept 融资 as a member and 融资规划/计划/策略 and 竞争计划 are strategy tokens; a body directly followed by 所辖/辖下/下属/旗下/所属/直管的 is a possessive and is neither receiver nor issuer; level counts accept 管控层(级)N级 for the N+1 credit, the 2型 two-level credit and the 2型 three-to-five manifestation; the non-related half accepts 不在…板块内 and 不属于…板块 when the span or its table row names the investment BU and does not abolish it; 投资管控(型) is a control-type name, not an investment word; a scope cell that is exactly 酒店BU, 投资BU or 养老公司 gives the row the hotel, diversified or pension subject; for bracket-only candidates in a role column the decline window reads the unmasked remainder of the sentence

length overrun is dose-response: S01 excess beyond its tolerance in bands of 0.3 Golden lengths (at least one band once any shape unit is over tolerance), keys shape:overrun:band1..N under the single causal root shape:overrun; nested S04 and S05 overruns stay manifestations of band 1; underrun is unchanged. D04 arch2:control_levels also reads an affirmed 2型 organisation of four or five layers (四层/四级 结构 or 架构) that names a business-unit layer, without transition wording.

核心企业/重点企业 are core-unit subjects; 发展策略 is a development token (组合发展策略 stays a portfolio token); a role-column approval table takes investment context from its nearest heading when it names 投资 or 资产变更 with 审批/决策/权限; 决定性 is a noun, not a role; a clause with 不(再)(越级)(直接)向/对/给 … 下达/下发/发指令 is a rule clause, and a sentence where 集团 … 不向 … 酒店/单位/存续业务/企业 … 下达 states the boundary; 园区/养老 unit patterns allow a space before BU and accept 养老…与园区…业务线设为(虚拟)单元; the functions-from-hotel-BU window is 24 characters and 不保留部门 counts as no departments; an N+1 two-level statement that names interfaces (…之间…之间) or says 与近期一致/相同 is not D05 and 管控…与近期一致 earns the N+1 level credit; the N+1 moves half skips clauses with 由集团直管 or 不纳入股份; a sentence that denies a BU the investment decision right (没有/无/不享有…投资决策权) yields no BU approval

the overrun tolerance decides whether a length violation exists; its dose is the whole S01 excess over the Golden length (ratio minus 1) in bands of 0.35 Golden lengths, at least one band once any shape unit is over tolerance; keys, causal root, nesting rule and the 0.8 coefficient are unchanged

in a role-column row a cell changes the row subject only when it names a subject outside brackets; the boundary accepts 目标…不由集团(直接)下达…由酒店BU/投资BU/股份 and 集团…不下达到…酒店/单位/企业; 不(另行|单独|再)下达 marks a rule clause in issuer rows and arrow cells; a table with a 下达方 header is target context for all its cells; 养老、园区两个(虚拟)业务单元 names both units; the non-related half rejects spans where the investment BU shrinks (收缩) or the businesses are handed over (改由…管理/处置); 各/每个业务类型 are the investment BU's units (material.md 622)
weights and the coefficients of D01 and D04 are contract parameters read at scoring time; predicates, shapes and band rules do not depend on them

a length overrun is charged as shape:overrun band instances under length_band (the R20 and R22 dose bands do not apply; nested S04 and S05 share the same instance keys, so a document carries at most overrun_instance_cap overrun instances)

required units of the brief: N+1 variant (ARCH_N1_HEADING anywhere, or P12 > 0), 2型 variant (ARCH_TWO_HEADING anywhere, or P13 > 0), headquarters departments (at least 3 of the settled department names), a non-rule target pair, and decision triples for at least 2 decision items; each absent unit is one D11 instance
the deliverable directory is output/; other regular non-hidden files there are D12 instances. Files submitted only at another path fail the strict delivery gate before the judge runs
a span whose Latin letters number at least 20 and exceed its CJK characters is not written in Chinese; one D13 instance per heading path

not_scored_golden_units.basis: Each exclusion below states why it carries no independent positive weight and where its remaining correctness is evaluated.

U02.reason: Group pension operating-control qualifier is context for P04, not an independent deliverable proposition.
U02.remaining_coverage: P04 evaluates the resulting pension decision chain; D01/D06 reject contradictory authority or positioning.

U06.reason: Group direct-object enumeration is settled background and copying the list would not improve the requested allocation.
U06.remaining_coverage: Target boundary and long-term destinations are evaluated in P14/P12; contradictions remain deductible.

U07.reason: Listed-company direct-object enumeration is structural context, not a separately weighted decision.
U07.remaining_coverage: P07, P14 and D02 evaluate incubation ownership and target responsibility.

U08.reason: Hotel-BU managed-object enumeration is carrier detail; the professional outcome is the hotel decision/target chain.
U08.remaining_coverage: P03 and P14 evaluate hotel authority and target issuance.

U09.reason: Investment-BU object scope is not rewarded for copying because omission is distinct from an adopted wrong scope.
U09.remaining_coverage: D02 source-bound review penalizes placing hotels/incubation under Investment BU; P11 evaluates its substantive duties.

U10.reason: Group management-focus prose restates the settled control type without a new allocation.
U10.remaining_coverage: D06 protects the settled type and P04/P14 evaluate operative consequences.

U11.reason: Listed-company management-focus prose is descriptive context rather than a discrete decision.
U11.remaining_coverage: P07/P14 cover its direct responsibilities; D01/D02 cover wrong allocations.

U12.reason: Hotel-BU management-focus prose is descriptive and would reward copying instead of allocation quality.
U12.remaining_coverage: P03/P14 cover unit decisions and targets.

U14.reason: The continuation-table heading has no standalone business proposition.
U14.remaining_coverage: Its decision rows are scored individually by P03/P04/P07 and deductions.

U18.reason: Core-hotel escalation is a conditional design choice not conclusively settled by the source.
U18.remaining_coverage: P03 scores the settled ordinary-unit final authority; no penalty applies to a supported explicit escalation.

U28.reason: Blank hotel-BU investment-approval cell is absence of authority, not affirmative content to copy.
U28.remaining_coverage: D08 penalizes granting unsupported final approval.

U29.reason: Blank Investment-BU investment-approval cell is absence of authority, not affirmative content to copy.
U29.remaining_coverage: P11 professional-review credit and D08 final-approval deduction cover the distinction.

U34.reason: Temporary restructuring exception is optional unless adopted; omission is not damage.
U34.remaining_coverage: P14 accepts the exception only with its condition and D02/D03 protect routing.

U40.reason: N+1 organisation-tree names are structural presentation, not a separate outcome beyond architecture meaning.
U40.remaining_coverage: P12 evaluates levels, destinations, BU nature and function ownership.

U41.reason: N+1 department-name inventory is not independently weighted because copying names can duplicate platform functions.
U41.remaining_coverage: P12 N1_FUNCTIONS evaluates professional function placement.

U48.reason: 2-type detailed hotel holding-mode list is unchanged source detail, not a new architecture decision.
U48.remaining_coverage: P13 evaluates platform, BU nature, levels and function receivers.

U49.reason: Ellipsis and illustrative future-BU labels are placeholders rather than settled business propositions.
U49.remaining_coverage: P13 gives credit for explicit actual BUs and coherent functions; hollow placeholders earn none.

gap_marker_contract_note: U30 approval thresholds: Materials give no amount; a marked threshold earns nothing and charges nothing, an invented amount triggers D10

length_band.meaning: Character counts are diagnostic only; no Golden-relative length penalty or lenient damage instance is emitted.
